title: How Inner Optimizers Shape Replica Scaling
abstract: arXiv:2610.19064v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Training large language models (LLMs) across geographically distributed and poorly interconnected compute pools or data centers has become a topic of significant interest. This has led to increased study of local optimization methods such as DiLoco for LLMs, especially those that use local (or inner) adaptive or preconditioned optimizers, which are critical for high-performance LLM training. However, a central challenge remains: it is well known that increasing the number of model replicas (replica scaling) while fixing the total training budget leads to monotonically decreasing performance. Existing work has empirically demonstrated that the choice of inner optimizer (Muon v.s. AdamW) can significantly improve this trend, but offers only limited explanation of the performance difference. translated_title: 内层优化器如何塑造副本扩展
translated_abstract: 在地理上分散且互连性较差的计算池或数据中心之间训练大语言模型（LLM）已成为备受关注的话题。这促使人们对诸如 DiLoco 等面向 LLM 的局部优化方法展开更多研究，尤其是那些使用局部（或内层）自适应或预条件优化器的方法，这些方法对高性能 LLM 训练至关重要。然而，一个核心挑战依然存在：众所周知，在固定总训练预算的情况下，增加模型副本数量（即副本扩展，replica scaling）会导致性能单调下降。已有工作从实证角度表明，内层优化器的选择（Muon 与 AdamW 之间）可以显著改善这一趋势，但对性能差异的解释却很有限。在这项工作中，我们考察了一系列内层优化器，并识别出影响副本扩展的两个重要因素：（1）梯度协方差结构……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 本文研究内层优化器对分布式 LLM 训练中副本扩展性能的影响，识别出决定不同内层优化器（如 Muon 与 AdamW）在副本扩展时表现差异的两个关键因素，从而解释了为何某些内层优化器能显著缓解副本数量增加带来的性能下降。
en_tdlr: This paper studies how inner optimizers shape replica scaling in distributed LLM training, identifying two key factors that explain why the choice of inner optimizer (e.g., Muon vs. AdamW) significantly mitigates the performance degradation caused by increasing model replicas under a fixed training budget.
